description: Money market mutual fund investment composition, monthly, from OFR's MMF Data Release — how much of aggregate MMF assets sit in repo (overall, or split by Treasury/agency/other collateral and by counterparty type: domestic institutions, foreign institutions, the Fed, FICC-cleared, other), plus outright Treasury/agency securities, bank-related assets, and other assets. Distinct from any credit-rating or fund-flow data — this is balance-sheet COMPOSITION. category defaults to repo_total; call ofr_search_funding_series with dataset:"mmf" to see all 42 underlying series (including median-yield variants).

limit.description: Max monthly observations to return. Default 24, max 200.
